about: acceptance item 2: pairs of claims about a project's or system's configuration, stated first (older) and later (newer) by the same source. 'expected' is 'changes' when the newer claim gives the configuration a new value (in either phrasing: 'uses B' or 'moved from A to B'), else 'not_changes' (coexisting tools, a vendor's price or a product's specification restated, history-only claims, added detail, a different attribute, a claim that relied on the old value). The bar: each row's label matched in at least two of three samples. Run with: uv run python scripts/replay_update_probe.py --set configuration
